notes.title: 🛠️ Chamber X - Full Release Update (June 2025)
notes.content: [p]Hey survivors,[/p][p][/p][p]A fresh update is now live for Chamber X! We’ve listened to your feedback and made several improvements to the full game. Here’s what’s new:[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Update Highlights:[/u][/b][/p][list][*][p]Revamped the UI and main menu for a better user experience,[/p][/*][*][p]Collision fixes in select hidden rooms for smoother navigation,[/p][/*][*][p]Item visuals updated for more immersive environments,[/p][/*][*][p]Increased range when interacting with notes and documents,[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced number of monsters to one — redesigned with a new look and texture,[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted item locations to improve pacing and discovery,[/p][/*][*][p]Improved visibility of the first key to help new players get started,[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you for playing and supporting Chamber X. More updates and content are on the way — stay tuned![/p][p] Share your feedback with us — every comment helps improve the game![/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3741430/CHAMBER_X/"] Play Chamber X on Steam[/url][/p]

notes.title: CHAMBER X is Now Live on Steam!
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p][/p][p]We’re thrilled to announce that CHAMBER X is now officially released on Steam! Thank you all for the amazing support during the demo phase — your feedback helped shape the game you can play today.[/p][p][/p][p]🔍 What’s Inside the Full Release:[/p][p][/p][p]New levels and puzzles 🧩[/p][p]Improved graphics and performance ⚙️[/p][p]Mystery deeper than ever before... 👁️[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]🙏 Support Us[/p][p]If you enjoy the game, please consider leaving a review or sharing it with friends.[/p][p]We’re a small indie team, and your feedback means the world.[/p][p][/p][p]🐞 Report Issues & Share Feedback[/p][p]If you find any bugs or have suggestions, please let us know via Steam discussions or our Discord.[/p][p][/p][p]💬 Stay connected:[/p][p]Join the discussion: https://steamcommunity.com/app/3741430/[/p][p]Follow us [url="https://linktr.ee/GamingUAE"]https://linktr.ee/GamingUAE[/url][/p][p]Join our Discord: [url="https://discord.gg/9etq92C"]https://discord.gg/9etq92C[/url][/p][p]Wishlist & Share![/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again, and welcome to Chamber X[/p][p]– The Dev Team 💀[/p]
